scope: Finite exact controls for a capped-rank theorem and generic planar fat-point class bound. Full fan counts are not fitted to a growth law. No unrestricted improvement, separating ideal family, class sharpness or novelty established.

uniform_theorem.generic_fat_points: For n=m*binom(r+1,2), generic planar nodes and every radical third coordinate give g=O(r^2*n^2*log(n+1)*(1+log r)); fixed r>=2 gives O_r(n^2*log(n+1)).
uniform_theorem.field_scope: Every infinite field has a nonempty open set by tensor CRT and nonzero minors. Finite-field fixtures verify the explicit rectangular-rank condition; existence over every finite field is not asserted.
uniform_theorem.class_boundary: Not all x^r-containing ideals, not arbitrary node configurations, not uniform matroid ranks.

capped_box_controls.claim_limit: Exact s_D; no maximum scanning count inferred from one fan certificate per cell.
